name: delegation-writer-requires-brief-input
description: log-delegation is invoked with every identity argument but no brief input. It must REFUSE: the whole point of the row is that the measurement was taken on the real brief, so a valid-looking row with brief_chars: 0 and exit 0 is worse than no row -- it looks measured and is not. Non-zero exit, a stderr message naming --brief-file, and no ledger written.
